fields.description: The item this operation is performed on — auto-filled from the BOM tree walk (the component's own item code for sub-assembly/subcontract steps, or the top-level item for its own BOM operations).
fields.label: Item

fields.description: The assembly item whose BOM consumes Item above — blank for the top-level item itself. Used to render the Summary's nested BOM tree; not shown in the grid.
fields.label: Parent Item

fields.description: Leave blank for subcontracted operations (e.g. Plating) with no in-house machine — type Rate / Pc directly instead.
fields.label: Machine

fields.description: Auto-filled from the BOM's default Tool for this Operation. Editable — pick a different tool if needed.
fields.label: Tool

fields.description: Pieces produced per cycle by the Tool above (e.g. mould cavities). Auto-fetched from the Tool, editable. Leave blank or 0 to skip dividing the rate.
fields.label: No of Cavities

fields.description: Auto-filled from Machine when empty. Editable override — kept as-is on later saves once set, same as Rate per Pc (no fetch_from: that would silently re-overwrite a manual override with the Workstation's current value on every save).
fields.label: Shift Rate per Min

fields.description: How many of THIS item go into one unit of the parent assembly. Only meaningful for a single-component operation — blank/unused when Assembly Breakdown (below) holds several components, since then it's a sum of several different quantities, not one number. Stays 1 (no effect) for a normal, non-Assembly operation.
fields.label: Qty Multiplier

fields.description: Internal — how this row's Rate/Pc was calculated when this Assembly-type operation (see Ujwal Industries Setting → Assembly Operation Names) consumes MULTIPLE manufactured sub-parts. A JSON list, one entry per sub-part: {"item": <item code>, "item_name": <item name>, "qty_multiplier": <how many of this item go into ONE finished unit>}. Rate/Pc = this operation's own per-cavity rate (Shift Rate ÷ Per Min/Pc) × each entry's qty_multiplier, summed across all entries — shown as a click-to-expand breakdown under this row in the Summary tab. This still shows as ONE row in the grid (a single assembly step done once), not one row per sub-part, even though the cost sums several. Blank for a normal or single-sub-part operation, which uses Qty Multiplier directly instead.
fields.label: Assembly Breakdown (JSON)

fields.description: Auto-computed from Machine when empty. Always editable — type your own rate to override (e.g. while the Machine's cost data isn't set up yet, or for a subcontractor's quoted rate). When a Tool with No of Cavities is set, this is the per-cavity rate (total rate ÷ cavities). For a multi-component Assembly operation, this is the SUM of that rate × each component's own quantity — see the per-component breakdown by expanding this operation's row in the Summary tab, or the Assembly Breakdown (JSON) field for the raw numbers.
fields.label: Rate per Pc
